body: MAINLINE-042 filed, QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION. Route: hot-creep-formed SR-200 blanks; vented CR-III core fitted to each face's measured contour (S-II's 0.010 in method); face-core bonds cured at panel level at 200 F with a 30.34:1 scarf (037b's fix, +0.12 kg); room-temperature seams made in place, Be cut only at the supplier; panels on a jig with supports at most 2 m apart, or an inflated inner skin as mandrel (my projection); ground evacuation as a 1.061 proof. No autoclave holds 20 m (largest 9.1 m; S-II's 10 m dome needed a 'gargantuan' one). Shape needed at 028b: one dimple at most 9.3-16.1 mm over 0.36 m (015b map) and waviness at most 0.075-0.129 mm (032). Precedents hold 1-5 mm (dome class) to 0.15 mm (reflector class), so the map gives gamma 0.69-0.95; reflector-panel faces give Q 0.59-0.75, vendor honeycomb 0.19-0.28. But S-II's sandwich domes, built to a 0.254 mm fit, measured 0.21-0.22: the map is not the record. The route supports gamma about 0.2 until a built shell is measured (038 T7); Q 0.435 needs reflector-grade Be faces, unmeasured. Inspection: photogrammetry and tracker at 0.1-0.3 mm suffice for shape; bond NDE is marginal (tap a90/95 28-43 mm against a 29-55 mm critical disbond); no scarf-seam method exists. Hardest step: 5.7 km of in-place room-temperature Be scarfs. First build-side test: F1, full-blank forming, panel and in-place seam with shape metrics, after 038's T1 and absorbing T2. 16 NFI rows. Next: none; the robotics seat sends the next job.
